production_gate.detail: 1024 production is blocked until a cropped recording is registered

backend_selection.detail: 1024 production needs a cropped recording; a generated clip cannot satisfy it

reason: The 1024 DNA requires 70% real screen-recording evidence. No intake-verified cropped user recording was provided. Generated animation is explicitly non-evidence and cannot substitute.
impact: No 45-60s formal 1024 video may be produced, approved or published from this project. Only the technical clip chain can be tested in a separate TEST_ONLY project.
fix_conditions: User provides an original manual screen recording
Recording passes intake and is cropped/redacted into a registered asset
Claim ledger binds the recording SHA-256 and usage permission
Formal M5 run is re-executed with has_real_recording=true
user_actions: Record the real CLI/browser workflow manually and supply the file
Confirm permission and which segments may be shown
Re-run M5 only after intake registers the recording
